cases.author_purpose_statement: Narratorial aphorism-to-close-POV seam, suspended descent for load-bearing family inventory, and dread-over-surprise preannouncement are deliberate passage choices worth tracking rather than passage-level errors; corpus frequency of aphoristic openings remains a separate pattern question.

The scene shifts from dramatized Shiphrah action under pressure to a Puah dossier/fact-sheet inventory, creating unequal treatment inside a matched-pair design and dulling the pressure already generated; the placement of the shared-history claim also risks a present-moment spatial mismatch.

Voice-distinguished unattributed dialogue, correction-as-engine, physicalized emotional reaction, clean time compression, and a room catalogue motivated through Paul's memory all serve the passage without exposition in disguise.

The future-pointing drums image, a closing inventory that partly restates earlier compression, and a small omniscient reach around Paul's simulated sleep are observable narrator-range choices; they are acceptable if the book's mobile-third and corpus pattern support them.

Sparse dialogue, two physical beats carrying subtext, characterization through the craft question, controlled repetition and escalation, and the closing Julius viewpoint all serve the passage's Rome-receives-Paul structure.

The passage intentionally pivots from warm comic arrival to custody by remeasuring the room; the barred door carries care and jailer functions simultaneously, and ambient street violence closes the movement effectively. Repeated narrator measurement of excess belongs to corpus-level pattern analysis, not passage-level failure.

Both Moses passages received non-clear labels (one neutral observation and one real limitation), while all three Unhindered dialogue-heavy passages were working as intended and the remaining Unhindered passage was neutral. This may reflect descriptive/expository stress selection, work-generation differences, or stronger dialogue handling; compare against preexisting blinded stress/control assignments and treat mismatches as evidence rather than tuning targets.
